svg.aria-label: Before and after. Before, reportProblem returns a decision and an fp- report id, the model repeats the id, and Inbox shows the report as an untagged question from an unknown worker. After, reportProblem returns where the report is (waiting in Inbox with a link, or filed with its Linear ID and URL), its tool line opens Inbox, the conversation says when a preview opens, Inbox resolves the link by the report's session and tags error reports with count and source.
